findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getQuestsV2, getQuestComments, replyToQuestComment, postQuest · Private data: getMyQuests · Public sink: getQuestsV2, replyToQuestComment, getQuestOffer · Destructive: getQuestComments, postQuest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getQuestsV2, getQuestComments, replyToQuestComment, postQuest · Private data: getMyQuests · Public sink: getQuestsV2, replyToQuestComment, getQuestOffer · Destructive: getQuestComments, postQuest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
